name: mado-system-one-reviewer
description: Review agent workflows for bounded decisions, evidence, policy boundaries, verification, and provider-semantics risks.

interface.longDescription: Review agent, automation, and multi-agent workflow designs for bounded decision surfaces, missing abstention paths, unsafe uses of confidence, policy-boundary leaks, weak evidence, missing independent verification, and provider-semantics mistakes. The plugin returns an evidence-aware audit and minimal repair plan. It reviews designs and traces; it does not execute external actions.
capabilities: Flag provider and confidence semantic risks
defaultPrompt: Audit this agent workflow for decision, policy, evidence, and verification gaps.
Review this router and show where NONE, ABSTAIN, or ESCALATE should exist.
Check this multi-agent design for unsafe confidence, ownership, and verification assumptions.
